reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster, primarily because it incorporates more targeted sessions for trail-specific strength and power development. Furthermore, the inclusion of a dedicated ‘aerobic’ session in Plan A is a smart way to build a solid base without excessive fatigue.
